يحتمل (form VIII)
# يَحْتَمِلُ (yaḥtamilu) /jaħ.ta.mi.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# يُحْتَمَلُ (yuḥtamalu) /juħ.ta.ma.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# يَحْتَمِلَ (yaḥtamila) /jaħ.ta.mi.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
